summary: Built a relocatable moderate generator, restored the missing derivative given, and repaired an answer-length cue. Passed source replay, mathematical checks, 425 native grading checks, delivery filtering, and eight visually inspected UI renders.
limitations: Only moderate generation is supported; easy lacks labelled evidence and hard lacks answer fields.
Original radio banks remain replay-only; new practice uses the documented authored bank extension.
Live learner history, database ordering, and concurrent inventory changes were not tested.
